description: Places a model view of a saved part or assembly on a drawing sheet (IDrawingDoc.CreateDrawViewFromModelView3): front, back, left, right, top, bottom, isometric, dimetric, trimetric, or a named view the model has, centred at a point in sheet mm (from the sheet's lower-left corner), at the sheet's scale or its own. The model must be a saved file: a never-saved model is refused before SOLIDWORKS is called (save it with sw_document_save_as first); a model with unsaved changes is drawn as it is in memory (model_unsaved says so). Checked by measuring: the view is on the sheet with the model, configuration and display asked; its centre reads back within 0.01 mm and its scale exactly; it faces the orientation asked (the model axis toward the reader from its model-to-sheet transform: +Z front, -Z back, +Y top, -Y bottom, +X right, -X left; equal components for isometric); what it draws (its edges) equals the model's bounding box projected and scaled within 0.01 mm for the six orthographic views, and lies inside it for the others; and the model is unchanged. Otherwise the view is deleted again (rolled back). Waits, changing nothing (busy, user_editing), while the user edits a view's sketch or the sheet format (sheet_format: true) or has a command open. After the user exits a view's sketch, SOLIDWORKS keeps that view activated and changes keep waiting until the user lets go of it: ask them to double-click the sheet outside every view.

document.description: The drawing: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

sheet.description: The sheet to put it on: a reference (r1.sheet.…) or a name. The sheet shown when absent; another is shown first.

model.description: The model: the full path of a saved .SLDPRT or .SLDASM, or the title of an open part or assembly that has been saved.

configuration.description: The model's configuration to show; the model's active one when absent.

orientation.description: front, back, left, right, top, bottom, isometric, dimetric, trimetric, or the name of a view the model has.

x.description: Mm to the right of the sheet's lower-left corner.

y.description: Mm above the sheet's lower-left corner.

at.description: Where its centre goes on the sheet, sheet mm from the lower-left corner.

numerator.description: The first number of the ratio, more than 0.

denominator.description: The second number of the ratio, more than 0.

scale.description: Its own scale (1:2 draws at half size); it follows the sheet's scale when absent.

display.description: hidden_lines_visible, hidden_lines_removed, wireframe, shaded or shaded_with_edges. Hidden lines visible for the six orthographic views of a part, hidden lines removed otherwise, when absent.
